sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.rights_summary: Predominantly US public-domain text; individual copyrighted exceptions. Catalog metadata public domain.
sources.access_method: Official bulk CSV/RDF and designated mirrors/robot interface; do not crawl ebook landing pages.
sources.review_note: Check original, translation, edition and jurisdiction. Issued date is ebook release date, not original publication.

sources.name: DraCor (24 live corpora observed; per-corpus licenses)
sources.rights_summary: Most corpora advertise CC0; exceptions include Folger-derived CC BY-NC material. Encoding license does not settle all underlying rights.
sources.access_method: Official API v1 /corpora and /corpora/{name}; reviewed TEI from pinned repositories.
sources.review_note: Resolve every corpus and play license; never inherit the platform default blindly. Live French corpus declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; keep it out of the default open training track.

sources.name: European Literary Text Collection
sources.rights_summary: English corpus states original texts public domain, markup CC BY 4.0; inspect each language collection and edition.
sources.access_method: Official per-language GitHub metadata TSV; pin commit before text ingestion.
sources.review_note: Curated multilingual novels. Existing digitizations include different providers; avoid double counting Gutenberg/other mirrors.

sources.name: Standard Ebooks
sources.rights_summary: Source text believed public domain in US; producer dedicates its own work to public domain.
sources.access_method: Official GitHub source repositories and authorized download routes.
sources.review_note: High-quality editions; often same works as Gutenberg. Global underlying copyright still needs assessment.

sources.name: Wikisource (including Chinese and multilingual editions)
sources.rights_summary: Public-domain works and individually licensed contributions/translations; not one license for every text.
sources.access_method: Wikimedia dumps/MediaWiki APIs; versioned page and scan provenance.
sources.review_note: Record original and translation licenses separately, proofread status, revision, scan and exact edition.

sources.name: Aozora Bunko
sources.rights_summary: Copyright-expired works and works made available with author permission coexist.
sources.access_method: Official catalog and sanctioned source files.
sources.review_note: Japanese public-domain determination is not worldwide clearance; author permission to host is not permission to redistribute.

sources.name: TextGrid Repository
sources.rights_summary: Per-object licensing and upstream edition review required; no platform-wide text clearance assumed.
sources.access_method: Repository metadata and TEI export.
sources.review_note: About 600 authors in its German Digital Library description is inventory, not cleared-work yield.

sources.name: Deutsches Textarchiv
sources.rights_summary: Inspect each TEI availability statement; no inferred license from documentation or repository code.
sources.access_method: DTA/TEI downloads after per-edition access and license review.
sources.review_note: Discovery lead; current text reuse policy requires item-level verification before ingestion.

sources.name: Blender Studio open films
sources.rights_summary: Studio content generally CC BY; exact script asset, credits and exceptions must be checked.
sources.access_method: Official film project and script asset download, where available.
sources.review_note: Modern authored film material, small yield. A film license or visible Script tab is not proof of an accessible licensed screenplay. Some access may require subscription.

sources.name: Direct rightsholder/film-school/playwright contributions
sources.rights_summary: Obtain worldwide public license from all necessary owners for the exact edition, translations and contributions.
sources.access_method: Voluntary delivered files with hash-bound public grant; no outreach sent by this tool.
sources.review_note: Priority route for contemporary screenplays and new unseen evaluation works; commissioning and incentives require separate budget.

sources.name: Library of Congress / National Screening Room
sources.rights_summary: Item-specific rights; no known US restrictions on much of the film collection, with exceptions and possible foreign rights.
sources.access_method: Official JSON API/catalog and authorized assets.
sources.review_note: Film is not screenplay. Keep derived ASR/subtitles and original script assets separate; do not infer script rights from film rights.

sources.name: Internet Archive / Prelinger and text collections
sources.rights_summary: Uploader license declarations are not guaranteed by the Archive.
sources.access_method: Official metadata API; open files only after independent provenance review.
sources.review_note: No borrowing, DRM, controlled lending or login-gated copies in this pipeline. Film/subtitle content is a separate auxiliary track.

sources.name: BnF / Gallica
sources.rights_summary: Metadata open-license terms and digitized-document reuse conditions are different; commercial reuse may require permission/fees.
sources.access_method: BnF metadata API/OAI; item-level rights and acquisition review before text.
sources.review_note: No blanket public-domain-to-global-reuse conversion.

sources.name: HathiTrust / HTRC
sources.rights_summary: Rights and access depend on volume, geography, digitizer and institution; research access is not redistribution permission.
sources.access_method: Bibliographic metadata; approved dataset request/API where eligible.
sources.review_note: Non-consumptive or institution-only access cannot be exported as open text.

sources.name: Folger Digital Texts / ShakeDraCor
sources.rights_summary: CC BY-NC 3.0 for these edited Shakespeare texts.
sources.access_method: Obtain a different applicable grant or choose another independently cleared edition.
sources.review_note: Not eligible for the default commercial-capable open track; do not strip edition license because Shakespeare is old.

sources.name: IMSDb
sources.rights_summary: No general worldwide redistribution/training grant established.
sources.access_method: Discovery and rightsholder permission only; no default crawler.
sources.review_note: A public reading copy does not establish ownership or onward dataset rights.

sources.name: Daily Script
sources.rights_summary: Homepage limits scripts to educational purposes.
sources.access_method: Contact rightsholder for suitable grant; no default crawler.
sources.review_note: Excluded from open training/full-text release absent a separate grant.

sources.name: SimplyScripts
sources.rights_summary: Links to professional, amateur, unproduced scripts and transcripts; permissions vary per author/host.
sources.access_method: Find authors/official studio assets; obtain exact-edition grant.
sources.review_note: Potential author recruitment channel, not a globally licensed corpus.

sources.name: Script Slug
sources.rights_summary: Current Terms sections 2 and 9 restrict copying and prohibit automated collection/AI dataset creation without written permission.
sources.access_method: No automated collection.
sources.review_note: Checked current terms, not merely ai.txt. Reconsider only through a documented policy change and explicit grant.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.rights_summary: Structured entity data CC0; no screenplay/novel text rights.
sources.access_method: SPARQL, entity APIs or dumps.
sources.review_note: Identity and film–novel–play adaptation graph; do not use descriptions as script targets.

sources.name: Open Library
sources.rights_summary: Bibliographic discovery; book-file rights independent.
sources.access_method: Official APIs for limited lookups, monthly dumps for bulk.
sources.review_note: Work/edition/author identity; a readable or borrowable book is not an open-data grant.

sources.name: Europeana
sources.rights_summary: Metadata CC0; linked digital objects governed by their own edm:rights.
sources.access_method: Official API (key required); no content permission inferred.
sources.review_note: Discover institutions and authoritative item rights; partition metadata from text.

sources.name: Zenodo research deposits
sources.rights_summary: Per-record licenses required; uploader must have underlying rights.
sources.access_method: Official records API and version DOI after review.
sources.review_note: Search for deposited drama/literary corpora; a permissive dataset label cannot relicense third-party scripts.

sources.name: OSF research deposits
sources.rights_summary: Project/file license and depositor authority must be reviewed independently.
sources.access_method: Official public project metadata; approved files only.
sources.review_note: Repository discovery, not a new independent source when duplicating another corpus.

sources.name: MovieSum (legacy only)
sources.rights_summary: Not a source for this expansion, by project scope.
sources.access_method: Legacy comparison/decontamination inventory only.
sources.review_note: No new acquisition or inclusion, even if a manifest labels it approved.
